mapper.select: SELECT id, feedback_id, user_id, rating, comment, evaluation_time FROM feedback_evaluation WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} ORDER BY evaluation_time DESC
SELECT id, feedback_id, user_id, rating, comment, evaluation_time FROM feedback_evaluation WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY evaluation_time DESC
SELECT AVG(fe.rating) as avgRating, COUNT(*) as count FROM feedback_evaluation fe INNER JOIN feedback f ON fe.feedback_id = f.id WHERE f.processed_by = #{processedBy}
SELECT rating, COUNT(*) as count FROM feedback_evaluation WHERE feedback_id = #{feedbackId} GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating
